data_description.schedule: Read-only access to the server's scheduler via the SOAP web services (port 10000). Default user: manager / password.

reauth_confirm.title: Web-services login
reauth_confirm.description: The server refused the login for the show schedule. Enter user and password again.

error.soap_failed: The web services (port 10000) did not answer or do not offer the scheduler.

abort.wrong_device: This is a different server (serial number differs).

data_description.fps: Used when the frame rate cannot be read from the CPL (needs KLV).
data_description.klv: DCP-2000 Messages API on port 11730: exact frame rates and titles for all CPLs, SPL control. Tested when saving.
data_description.schedule: Read only: GetScheduleList / GetScheduleInfo / GetSchedulerStatus / GetSPLListInfo. Tested when saving.
data_description.day_start_hour: Late shows after midnight count to the previous day until this hour.
data_description.pause_limit: A show ends on stop/eject. Only a pause longer than this counts as end (forgotten playlist).
data_description.external_players: Optional. Blu-ray/Apple TV players or sensors with the remaining time in seconds. While the server pauses, the remaining time of the first playing one is added to the expected end.

error.klv_unreachable: The KLV API did not answer on this port.
error.soap_failed: The web services (port 10000) did not answer or do not offer the scheduler.

cue_clip.name: Cue clip
cue_clip.description: Loads a clip via auto mode (In/Out preset) and optionally starts it.

clip.name: Clip
clip.description: Clip ID (8 characters), library label or CPL title.

queue_clip.name: Queue next clip
queue_clip.description: Sets the preview preset so this clip plays after the current one.

projector_channel.name: Projector channel
projector_channel.description: Switches the projector channel via the server.

set_gpo.name: Set GPO byte
set_gpo.description: Writes all 8 GPO lines at once (bit 0 = line 1).

send_command.name: Send raw command
send_command.description: Sends a Sony 9-pin frame in hex (checksum is added).

list_content.name: List content
list_content.description: Returns clips (and CPLs/SPLs/KDMs if the KLV API is enabled).

spl_load.name: Load show playlist
spl_load.description: Loads a show playlist by UUID or XML (KLV API).

store.name: Store only
store.description: Store (ingest) instead of loading for playback.

spl_uuid.name: SPL
spl_uuid.description: Title or UUID of a stored SPL (instead of XML).

start.name: Start
start.description: Optional: play, or pause = run the pre-show checks and park on the first frame.

spl_jump.name: Jump in SPL
spl_jump.description: Jumps forward/back (negative) in the current CPL. Only while paused; firmware may ignore the value and use 180 s.

spl_retrieve.name: Retrieve SPL
spl_retrieve.description: Returns the XML of a stored SPL.

measure_frame_rate.name: Measure frame rate
measure_frame_rate.description: Determines the frame rate of the loaded clip (brief locate and back, only while paused). Stored per clip.

load_content.name: Load content
load_content.description: Loads a CPL or a show playlist. 'play' runs it; 'pause' parks it on its first frame (an SPL runs its pre-show checks for that, ~30-60 s). Automation cues of an SPL are executed when it plays.

id.name: Content
id.description: Clip id, CPL title, SPL title or UUID.

seek.name: Seek
seek.description: Jumps inside the current clip / SPL element. Cinema mode: only while paused; Mediaplayer mode: also while playing (pause, jump, play).

position.name: Position
position.description: Seconds from the start of the clip.

offset.name: Offset
offset.description: Seconds relative to the current position (negative = back).

skip_to_event.name: Skip to SPL event
skip_to_event.description: Jumps to an event of the loaded SPL. Only while the show is paused.

index.name: Index
index.description: Position in the event list (0 = first).

eject.name: Eject
eject.description: Ejects the loaded SPL, or the clip if no SPL is loaded.

get_library.name: Library
get_library.description: Returns all CPLs and SPLs with titles for selection dialogs.

step_frames.name: Step frames
step_frames.description: Steps single frames forward/back (negative). The server stays paused.

get_schedule.name: Get schedule
get_schedule.description: Raw scheduler answers of the server and the tracking state (read only, for checks).

cinema_locked.message: Cinema mode: pause the server first (or switch the transport mode to Mediaplayer).

starting.message: Playback is starting (pre-show checks) - try again when it runs.
